  WHY: When a reference is absent, staging emits a misleading warning and continues; downstream review_rb_judge.sh / review_run_judge_interim.sh then hard-fails the render step, causing the entire judge path to exit 1 and fall to ai:review-blocked recovery.
- scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:257-275 (new for-loop for reference_asset staging) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The loop only stages when the target is absent (`if [ ! -f ... ]`); it never refreshes a stale or corrupted reference file already present in SUPPORT_PROMPTS_DIR/references/.
  WHY: A partial prior bootstrap or older support checkout can leave an outdated reference; subsequent runs will use the stale file instead of the fresher copy from .codex-workflow-src*, breaking placeholder hydration for judge/consolidator prompts.
